scenario: Host-like default pair: a btrfs /home subvolume (mountinfo major:minor 0:30 while the path's st_dev is 0:57, i.e. the per-subvolume anonymous device) whose single listed uuid carries device dm-0 with the qgroups directory absent (qgroups false, qgroups_enabled null, qgroups_mode null), plus an xfs /tmp whose super options end in noquota and whose major:minor equals the path st_dev.

fixture.mountinfo:
25 1 0:30 / / rw,relatime shared:1 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,relatime,ssd,space_cache,subvolid=256,subvol=/@
26 25 0:30 /@home /home rw,relatime shared:1 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,relatime,ssd,space_cache,subvolid=257,subvol=/@home
29 25 8:2 / /tmp rw,relatime - xfs /dev/sda2 rw,attr2,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=32k,noquota

rationale:
Corrected case authored under the round-23 pre-seal amendment (.ufo/waves/round-23/preseal-amendment.md), which supersedes only the erroneous/ambiguous clauses of contract.md section C2. DELTA versus the original proposal cases-proposed/CaseHostLike.json (retained untouched): the single btrfs_sysfs UUID record gains the now-required member qgroups_enabled, set to null because the original qgroups is false (an absent qgroups directory has no qgroups/enabled file and no qgroups/mode file); the record therefore carries exactly the keys devices, qgroups, qgroups_enabled, qgroups_mode. Nothing else changes: the mountinfo text, the paths, device_links, the btrfs_sysfs values, the expected block and the sources list are identical, because this case touches none of the amended branches (no ext2/3/4 path, no duplicated covering mount point, no btrfs qgroups directory present, no device-mismatch preemption for a nonzero btrfs stat major).
FIXTURE METADATA (amendment, fixture source resolution and metadata rules). The raw decoded mount source '/dev/mapper/root' is looked up in device_links and its mapped basename 'dm-0' is compared against the uuid devices list; exactly one uuid lists 'dm-0', so the device is mapped and the 'zero or several uuids' case does not apply. Paths are nonempty, unique and normalized absolute (realpath == path, no dot/dotdot components); st_dev values are canonical decimal MAJ:MIN ('0:57', '8:2', no signs, no leading zeros other than the major '0'); the uuid key is a canonical uuid; devices and the device_links value are plain nonempty basenames without slashes or control characters; the qgroups fields have exact types (false / null / null). The mountinfo text carries no backslash escapes, so the octal decoding of root, mount point and source is a no-op here.
PATH 1 (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin, btrfs). Mount resolution: the covering mount points are '/' and '/home' (realpath starts with '/home/'), each occurring exactly once in the fixture, so the new 'ambiguous_overmount' refusal does not fire; the longest mount point wins, hence '/home' (btrfs, major:minor 0:30). Device check: under the amendment a device mismatch PREEMPTS the filesystem table, but the btrfs equality skip applies because the path's stat major is 0 (0:57), so the 0:30 vs 0:57 difference is the expected per-subvolume anonymous device (device_check btrfs_subvolume_skipped) and the btrfs table is reached; a nonzero btrfs stat major that mismatches the mount would instead give unknown / n/a / device_mismatch. Quota classification: under the amendment the qgroups directory's presence means INITIALIZED, not enabled, and the qgroups/enabled file decides; this fixture has qgroups false with enabled null and mode null, i.e. the /sys/fs/btrfs/<uuid>/qgroups directory is ABSENT and the parent inspection succeeded (the uuid has a record), so the absent-dir row is retained: disabled / n/a / btrfs_qgroups_dir_absent, with btrfs_qgroups_mode null. Anchors: S079 fs/btrfs/sysfs.c (the 'qgroups' kobject is created by btrfs_sysfs_add_qgroups() at 2586, kobject added as "qgroups" at 2604-2605; attributes enabled 2368 and mode 2395), S080 fs/btrfs/qgroup.c (btrfs_qgroup_mode() 33-40 returns BTRFS_QGROUP_MODE_DISABLED unless BTRFS_FS_QUOTA_ENABLED; btrfs_sysfs_add_qgroups() is called from the quota-enable paths 441 and 1032), S081 fs/btrfs/inode.c:8246 (stat->dev = BTRFS_I(inode)->root->anon_dev;). A btrfs quota mechanism is sysfs-based, not mount-option-based, so quota_option_keys for this path is [].
PATH 2 (/tmp, xfs). Covering mount points are '/' and '/tmp', each occurring exactly once, so 'ambiguous_overmount' does not fire; '/tmp' is the longest and equals the realpath, so the xfs line is chosen. Its major:minor 8:2 equals the path st_dev 8:2, so device_check is match (S082: proc.rst section 3.5 field (3), major:minor is the st_dev for files on the filesystem). Quota classification: the super options are the last three fields of this line, 'rw,attr2,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=32k,noquota'; split on commas with key = text before '=', the keys are rw, attr2, inode64, logbufs, logbsize, noquota, of which only noquota is quota-related (logbufs/logbsize are value-carrying non-quota keys). The xfs precedence is conflict (noquota together with ANY quota/enforcement/noenforce key) first, then noquota, then any enforced key, then any accounting-only key, else absent; there is no quota key, no noenforce key and no conflict, so the noquota row applies: disabled / n/a / xfs_noquota_option. Under the amendment quota_option_keys for this path is ['noquota'] (noquota and recognized xfs keys only, sorted). Anchors: S078 fs/xfs/xfs_super.c (fsparam_flag("noquota", Opt_noquota) at 158; xfs_showargs() emits ',noquota' at 254 exactly when no quota accounting flag is set), S077 xfs quota documentation.
VERDICT. Neither path is enabled and neither is unknown, so the contract precedence yields exit 0 with finding_id QUOTA_DISABLED. The six scored output fields per path are asserted here; the supplementary fields (device_check btrfs_subvolume_skipped / match, quota_option_keys [] / ['noquota'], btrfs_qgroups_mode null / null) are stated in this rationale and are not added to the expected tuples, which the case format fixes to exactly path, fstype, mount_point, quota_state, enforcement, basis.
